properties.name: problem.type-url
properties.description: Base URL of a page that documents problem codes, such as https://example.com/problems. When set, the problem 'type' is this URL with the problem code as fragment, e.g. https://example.com/problems#order-not-found. Applies to every advice that calls Exceptional#toResponse, including application advices. Must be an absolute URI. When unset, 'type' is about:blank.

properties.name: problem.dao-advice-enabled
properties.description: Whether to turn data-integrity, duplicate-key, and concurrency (optimistic and pessimistic locking) exceptions into problem responses. When false, the Throwable fallback handles them.

properties.name: problem.security-advice-enabled
properties.description: Whether to turn Spring Security authentication and access-denied exceptions into problem responses, and to register the problem AuthenticationEntryPoint and AccessDeniedHandler beans.
